items.summary: Was Greg Brockman the right executive all along?

items.title: OpenAI releases its official report on the Hugging Face breach
items.summary: The report, which spans several discrete cybersecurity compromises, is the most complete accounting of the incident to date.

items.title: Flipboard acquires Graze, the feed builder working to monetize the open social web
items.summary: Flipboard is acquiring Bluesky feed-building startup Graze, bringing its privacy-friendly ad technology and creator monetization tools into Flipboard’s growing open social web ecosystem.

items.title: Medical device maker Boston Scientific says a cyberattack is causing a ‘global disruption’ to its operations
items.summary: The company won't say if medical devices are affected or if any customer data was exfiltrated.

items.title: US seizes domains of Chinese botnet used to hack NASA, Justice Department, and the Senate
items.summary: The FBI has seized domains associated with a botnet that allowed Chinese-backed hackers to breach several U.S. government departments.

items.title: Capital F closes $17M debut fund with goal to back the future of the ‘female economy’
items.summary: Capital F, one of the few all-female-led VC firms, announced Wednesday the $17 million close of its debut fund. The firm backs companies building in the “female economy” — or the markets where women drive demand. That mainly falls into three buckets for the firm, Margaret Coblentz, the firm’s co-founder, told TechCrunch — women’s health, […]

items.title: Apple is holding its iPhone launch event on September 9
items.summary: The event is expected to be a notable one, as Apple is rumored to unveil its long-awaited foldable iPhone. It'll also be the first Apple event with John Ternus as CEO, who is scheduled to take the reins of the tech giant from Tim Cook on September 1.

items.title: Meta agrees to sweeping changes to restrict kids’ access to its apps as part of settlement with states
items.summary: One of the most notable changes is that Meta plans to implement a daily two-hour time limit for teens that can only be disabled with parental permission.

items.title: What’s driving Sweden’s startup boom, from Lovable to Legora
items.summary: Vibe-coding darling Lovable just raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation, roughly doubling its worth in eight months. But Lovable isn’t the only Stockholm startup putting up huge numbers lately — legal AI company Legora and health tech startup Neko Health are right there with it. On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Dominic-Madori Davis…

items.title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
items.summary: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.

items.title: Ex-Meta scientists want to bring visual AI to the factory floor
items.summary: Perceptron offers an AI model that it says can help machines navigate the world while also providing in-depth visual intelligence.

items.title: Ring introduces a new encryption standard, makes it the default for cloud features
items.summary: Ring says users can still opt for end-to-end encryption.

items.title: Bill Gates wants to see a robot tax and ‘Human Reserved’ jobs to mitigate harms from AI
items.summary: Gates is mostly in the Responsible AI camp, but there are a few ideas in here we hadn't heard before.

items.title: CISA confirms hackers targeted over 100 US water systems during July
items.summary: The federal cyber agency's warning comes amid a wave of suspected Iran-backed cyberattacks targeting critical water systems across the United States.

items.title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model
items.summary: Z.ai confirms it is behind Ox Alpha, the mysterious open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards, and its weights are set to be released soon.

items.title: Meta settles for $18 billion in lawsuit brought by 29 states over social media harms to children
items.summary: The lawsuit alleged that Meta knowingly designed platforms like Instagram and Facebook to addict children, despite knowing about the harms the platforms could pose to young users.

items.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
items.summary: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.

items.title: Bluesky now lets you upload 10-minute long videos
items.summary: Bluesky's new 10-minute video support includes faster upload speeds, too.

items.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
items.summary: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.
